Name: Stardew Furniture for Content Patcher
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
Have you ever went into an NPC's house and looked around and were like "wow I wish I could use the stuff they had scattered around" ? 

Well now you can! And in 1.6 too! At least a good majority of it anyways. This content patcher furniture pack adds 340 individual furniture items (paintings, decorations, tables, etc...) for you to use to decorate your farm! 

Transitioning this to content patcher definitely was a learning process... and tedious, but everything should work. If there are any errors simply let me know and I'll work on fixing it. Also let me know if there's any other hidden furniture you want in the game! I didn't check 1.6's files yet. 

There's a mod page for 1.5 as well but in order to keep the mod accessbile to 1.5 people, I've done this :]

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12756]1.5 Version

[/url]Check out [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26479]This Mod[/url] for movie theater furniture!
And [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12783]This Mod[/url] for stuff in Clint's Workshop!

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]
